**YMCA OF METROPOLITAN LOS ANGELES**


The LA Y is the Center for Community Well\-Being in Los Angeles, committed to building stronger communities by providing equitable programs and services to empower all. We are focused on fighting food insecurity, providing equity in education, making sure every child has the opportunity to experience the joy of sports, ensuring kids and teens have a safe place to grow, learn and live a healthy lifestyle. The LA Y’s health and wellness initiatives offer medical and mental health resources to ensure everyone has access to basic health needs. Our mission is to provide services and resources that contribute to the well\-being of our community. The LA Y operates 29 Centers and over 200 program sites across LA County.




**POSITION SUMMARY**

* Manage the day\-to\-day implementation of the AmeriCorps Seniors RSVP program across an assigned region of YMCA centers and volunteer stations.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned centers and volunteer stations, conducting regular check\-ins and providing ongoing guidance, communication, and program support.
* Lead regional recruitment efforts to identify and engage eligible AmeriCorps Seniors volunteers, supporting progress toward program recruitment and engagement goals.
* Build relationships with YMCA senior programs, center staff, community organizations, senior centers, and other local partners to expand volunteer recruitment and participation.
* Regularly engage with senior programming at assigned YMCA centers to share volunteer opportunities and connect older adults with meaningful service opportunities.
* Support volunteers through enrollment, onboarding, training, placement, and ongoing engagement within their assigned volunteer stations.
* Provide guidance and support to volunteer station leads to ensure they understand AmeriCorps Seniors expectations, volunteer processes, program activities, and applicable requirements.
* Coordinate volunteer participation across RSVP service activities, including community outreach, food and nutrition support, referrals, workshops, and other approved program activities.
* Conduct regular in\-person and virtual check\-ins with volunteer station leads to monitor recruitment, volunteer participation, program needs, challenges, and progress toward established goals.
* Support the delivery and coordination of volunteer training, orientation, continued learning opportunities, and program resources.
* Monitor regional volunteer activity and work with the Project Director and Program Associate to ensure volunteer enrollment, service hours, training, and other required program information are accurately captured.

* Implement communication plans, processes, and program guidance established by the Project Director to ensure consistency across regions and volunteer stations.
* Identify regional challenges, volunteer needs, and opportunities for program improvement and communicate findings to the Project Director.
* Grant Funded Position: Continued employment is contingent upon the availability of grant funding, ongoing program needs, and satisfactory job performance. Funding beyond the current grant period is not guaranteed.

At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we're revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end\-to\-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.


The CIH Inventory \& Leads Program serves as the primary engine for capturing and converting high\-intent consumer traffic into real estate transactions. Through strategic partnerships with Redfin.com and Rocket Mortgage, the program delivers a diversified lead pipeline to agents, including high\-volume web inquiries and "finance\-first" pre\-qualified buyers.



As a **Program Coordinator, Leads**, you are responsible for serving as the operational backbone of the CIH Inventory \& Leads Program by owning the intake, resolution, and continuous improvement of all field\-facing inquiries. You will work closely with Corporate Strategy and cross\-functional partners to ensure issues are resolved quickly and accurately while identifying root causes and strengthening the systems that support execution. This is an operations\-focused role at the intersection of support, process improvement, and field experience, ensuring inbound inquiries are handled efficiently while transforming recurring issues into structured insights that enhance product, streamline processes, and reduce future demand.


**Core Responsibilities**



* Inbound Queue Ownership


* Own the centralized intake of all agent and field inquiries related to CIH inventory and leads, across inboxes, slack channels, feedback loops and escalations
* Triage, prioritize, and resolve issues with urgency and sound judgment
* Maintain and enforce response SLAs (same\-day where possible)
* Create structure in what is currently a fragmented inbound environment

* Resolution Excellence \& Field Communication


* Deliver clear, actionable, and consistent responses to agents and field leaders to enable, surprise and delight
* Ensure appropriate visibility to RVPs, Sales Managers, and Agent Experience partners
* Standardize response frameworks to eliminate variability and confusion
* Act as a trusted point of contact for field\-facing issue resolution

* Pattern Recognition \& Issue Escalation


* Identify recurring issues, friction points, and systemic gaps
* Categorize inbound volume into actionable themes
* Translate field pain into structured insights for Product, PMO, and leadership
* Data for support and QA resourcing; insights for EC; evidence for prioritization by product
* Escalate with clarity. It is imperative to separate noise from true signal

* Knowledge Systems \& Enablement


* Build and maintain a centralized knowledge base and SSOT, including:
* + FAQs
	+ Response templates for cross\-functional teams
	+ Escalation playbooks to product, support
* Continuously refine documentation based on real\-world usage
* Partner with Field Enablement to proactively reduce inbound questions
* Drive the shift from reactive support self\-service \+ proactive education

* Cross\-Functional Coordination


* Serve as the daily connection between Field, Product, PMO, and Marketplace teams
* Ensure issues are not only resolved, but addressed at the root level
* Track and follow through on escalations to closure
* Hold a high bar for operational accountability across teams


**Success Metrics**


* SLA adherence (response time)
* Time to resolution
* Reduction in repeat / duplicate inquiries
* % of issues resolved at root cause (vs. one\-off fixes)
* Field sentiment and confidence in the program
* Adoption and utilization of knowledge base resources


**Ideal Profile**


* Highly structured operator who thrives in ambiguity and brings order to complex systems
* Exceptional written and verbal communicator—clear, concise, and action\-oriented
* Strong pattern recognition and problem\-solving skills
* Comfortable managing high\-volume workflows without sacrificing quality
* Experience in real estate, marketplace operations, or support functions preferred
* Bias toward ownership


**Work Location \& Schedule:** This is a full\-time, agent and brokerage\-facing position (40 hours per week) and ideally in a Compass International Holdings Hub location.


**Compensation:** The expected base pay for this position is $25 \- $30 per per hour. This range reflects our good\-faith estimate of what we intend to offer for this role at the time of posting. Final offers within this range will depend on job\-related factors such as experience, skills, and internal equity. We remain committed to fair pay practices and compliance with all California transparency requirements.

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Under supervision, assists in or plans, develops, implements and coordinates a variety of programs in area of specialty such as health, human services, housing, neighborhoods, youth or other programs; researches and makes recommendations on needs issues; prepares and presents analysis and recommendations; acts as liaison and program source to individuals, city and community groups, a variety of organizations and agencies; advises and ensures City compliance with related laws, regulations and ordinances; and a performs related work as assigned.
  

  

**CLASS CHARACTERISTICS**
  

Incumbents manage, implement, develop and coordinate special programs that have a broad impact and are designed to meet specific needs of the community or members of a target population. These programs are often established on a temporary or limited term basis to meet short\-term City goals or specific grant funding objectives.
  

  

Positions are assigned at the I, II or III level based on the size, diversity and complexity of the program and its interrelationship in the community.
  

  

PROGRAM COORDINATOR I \- This is the working level class in the Program Coordinator series. Employees in this class assist higher level program coordinators, management or supervisory/management staff members in various program tasks and projects covering a range of issues associated with program assignment. In addition, incumbents are assigned on going projects or areas of responsibility. Assignments are made under general supervision, allowing the incumbent latitude in managing and completing on going projects/assignments. Assignments and objectives are set for the employee and established work methods are to be followed. Employee has some flexibility in the selection of steps and timing of a work process. Work review is occasional during progress and upon completion. Normally, the employee is responsible for handling routine work problems and the satisfactory achievement of specified objectives. Positions in this class may slide to the II level if the subject position is budgeted at the II level and after an evaluation by management of employee knowledge, skills and abilities.
  

  

**PROGRAM COORDINATOR II** \- This is the journey level class in the Program Coordinator series. Positions in this class are typically filled by advancement from the lower level Program Coordinator I class or when filled from outside, require prior program management experience. Appointment to this class requires that the employee be performing the full range of duties for the class and meet the qualification standards for this class. A Program Coordinator II works under limited supervision and is expected to perform the full range of analytical work requiring complete knowledge of program requirements. Work assigned to this class is distinguished from the I level by the greater complexity of assignments received, broader range of duties and the greater independence with which an incumbent is expected to operate. This class is distinguished from the Program Coordinator I class by incumbent's ability to take responsibility for moderately complex programs or to provide support to a Program Coordinator III in the more complex programs. Typically, level 1 Program Coordinators would provide support to level 2 Program Coordinators.
  

  

*PROGRAM COORDINATOR III* \- This is the advanced journey level class in the Program Coordinator series. Incumbents provide advanced program management and professional assistance in planning, developing, directing and coordinating complex programs and projects either directly or through assigned staff. This class is distinguished from the Program Coordinator II by the difficulty and complexity of work performed, responsibility over the development and/or administration of a significant, complex and sensitive program. This class also requires the use of a high degree of independent judgment in making decisions. In addition, incumbents in this class are required to supervise professional level staff on a regular and continuing basis.

Reporting directly to the Head of Sales and Operations, you will act as their right hand, keeping sales and operations running day to day and making sure commitments made get done.

**About Hyakunousha**

Hyakunousha (百農社) is the parent company of OMUSUBI, a brand dedicated to connecting people and enriching communities through Japanese culinary culture. Rooted in the tradition of omusubi—a symbol of warmth, care, and nourishment—we are committed to fostering a people\-first, genuinely caring workplace.

As we expand into the United States, our goal is to introduce the heart of Japanese cuisine and the spirit of *omotenashi*: exceptional hospitality delivered with sincerity.

**Position Overview**

The Integrated Marketing Manager will lead the development and execution of local marketing strategies that drive customer traffic, revenue growth, brand awareness, and customer loyalty.

The successful candidate will own integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social media, PR, events, community engagement, CRM, new store openings, and promotional initiatives. This role requires strong commercial acumen, budget management capabilities, and the ability to evaluate marketing effectiveness through sales and performance metrics.

The role will work closely with Operations, Finance, Headquarters, external agencies, media partners, and community stakeholders to build the OMUSUBI brand and support future expansion across California and the United States.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Growth \& Commercial Leadership**

* Develop and execute marketing strategies aligned with sales and business growth objectives.
* Translate business targets into actionable marketing plans and measurable KPIs.
* Monitor and evaluate marketing investments against traffic, sales, conversion, and ROI targets.
* Provide recommendations based on customer, market, and competitive insights.
* Partner with Operations and senior leadership to support revenue growth and store expansion.

**Integrated Marketing Campaign Management**

* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns.
* Manage campaigns across digital marketing, social media, PR, local store marketing, influencer marketing, community partnerships, in\-store promotions, and customer engagement programs
* Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful campaign delivery.
* Measure campaign effectiveness and identify improvement opportunities.

**Customer Engagement \& CRM**

* Develop customer retention and loyalty strategies.
* Drive customer acquisition, repeat purchase, and customer lifetime value.
* Manage CRM initiatives including email marketing, SMS Marketing, loyalty programs, customer database growth, customer segmentation strategies
* Utilize customer insights and analytics to improve engagement and business performance.

**Public Relations \& Event Management**

* Lead planning and execution of marketing events and public relations activities.
* Organize Store Opening Events, Community Engagement Programs, Brand Activations, Media Events, Influencer Events, and Corporate Partnerships
* Build relationships with media, community organizations, business associations, and external partners.
* Drive positive brand exposure and earned media opportunities.

We are looking for someone who already runs their own stack of agents and automations, who treats “a human did this manually” as a bug, and who measures themselves by what moved forward — not by what got scheduled.

* A business operations owner. jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Social Media Manager who understands restaurants, creates content that gets attention, and can prove their work gets results. This is not a position for someone looking to build their first portfolio or gain their first restaurant client. We’re looking for someone with hands\-on restaurant social media management experience, a strong creative eye, and a proven track record of measurable results.

What You’ll Do

* Manage social media accounts for restaurant and hospitality clients
* Develop and execute social media strategies specifically for restaurants
* Create, coordinate, and/or oversee photo and video content
* Plan and maintain content calendars
* Capture on\-site content at client locations
* Develop creative concepts for Reels, TikToks, Stories, posts, and other social content
* Stay current with social media trends, sounds, formats, and platform changes
* Write engaging captions and create content designed to drive customer action
* Monitor analytics and adjust strategy based on performance
* Track key metrics including reach, engagement, views, follower growth, website traffic, and other relevant KPIs
* Coordinate content around promotions, events, menu launches, holidays, and other restaurant\-specific opportunities

RESTAURANT EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED

You must have previous experience specifically managing social media for restaurants, bars, cafés, hospitality groups, or other food \& beverage businesses. We are not looking for someone whose experience is primarily:

* Personal social media
* Influencer accounts
* General social media with no restaurant experience
* Posting content without developing the strategy
* Managing accounts without tracking performance

We want someone who understands the restaurant industry and knows how to create content that gets people to stop scrolling, visit, order, book, or engage.

YOUR PORTFOLIO IS REQUIRED

DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT A PORTFOLIO. We are intentionally requiring a portfolio because we want to eliminate applicants who are simply applying to every available position. Your portfolio must demonstrate real restaurant social media work that you personally managed or contributed to.

We want to see:

* Restaurant accounts you have managed
* Examples of your actual work
* Your specific role and responsibilities
* Examples of successful content
* Campaigns or strategies you implemented
* Trackable analytics and performance data
* Before\-and\-after results when available
* Reach, impressions, engagement, views, follower growth, website traffic, or other relevant KPIs

Screenshots of analytics are strongly encouraged. A portfolio consisting solely of attractive posts without any indication of performance will not be considered sufficient. We want to know: What did you do?  
Why did you do it?  
And what happened as a result?

ON\-SITE CONTENT REQUIREMENT

Although this position does not require you to live locally, you must live close enough to the client location(s) to physically visit the businesses when required. You will be required to be physically present at client locations for content creation a minimum of 2 scheduled days per month.

These on\-site days will be used to:

* Capture photo and video content
* Film Reels/TikToks
* Capture behind\-the\-scenes content
* Highlight food, drinks, staff, atmosphere, and experiences
* Capture timely content that cannot be created remotely
* Stay familiar with the restaurant, team, brand, and customer experience

If you are not within a reasonable traveling distance of the client location(s) and cannot commit to a minimum of 2 on\-site content days per month, this position will not be a fit.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE REQUIRED

Restaurant marketing doesn’t always happen from 9\-5\. You must be willing to work flexible hours based on client needs and content opportunities. This may include occasional:

* Evenings
* Weekends
* Special events
* Grand openings
* Menu launches
* Promotions
* Restaurant events
* Other time\-sensitive content opportunities

We are looking for someone who can communicate clearly, plan ahead, and be flexible when the work requires it.

COMPENSATION

$1,000–$5,000\+ per month based on client load. This position operates on a tiered compensation structure based on the number of clients you manage. The more restaurant accounts you successfully manage, the higher your monthly compensation. 8 clients is the maximum client load for this position.

Compensation within each tier may be determined by the specific responsibilities, workload, and client requirements associated with the accounts assigned.

This structure is designed for someone who is capable of taking on multiple restaurant accounts while maintaining quality, consistency, communication, and measurable results.

We are not interested in simply assigning you more accounts. You must be able to successfully manage the accounts assigned to you.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate is:

* Experienced in restaurant social media
* Creative and highly observant
* Comfortable filming content on\-site
* Comfortable working directly with restaurant teams
* Data\-driven and able to interpret analytics
* Organized and dependable
* Able to work independently
* Strong at communication and client management
* Familiar with Instagram and TikTok trends
* Comfortable adapting content based on performance
* Flexible with their schedule
* Able to reliably travel to client locations at least 2 times per month
* Focused on results, not simply posting for the sake of posting

MBS Innovations is a recruiting agency focused on AI and engineering talent. We opened under nine months ago and are already past seven figures in revenue, and we're hiring to keep up. Our founder spent 18 years helping build one of the largest tech staffing agencies in America before starting his own, and he's in the trenches with the team every day rather than managing from a distance. We plan to add 20\+ people before the end of the year.

**Our clients**

We recruit for AI labs, the infrastructure companies much of the industry runs on, and applied AI startups growing quickly. Most are backed by well\-known venture and strategic investors. We also work with Fortune 1000 companies standing up serious AI and engineering teams for the first time.

The work these companies are doing is not incremental. Some are building the models and compute everything else gets built on. Some are working on drug discovery and cutting years off the time it takes to get a treatment to a patient. Some are launching hardware into orbit. Some are rebuilding the power grid, or the tools that let a single engineer do what used to take a team of fifty.

The common thread is that the engineers they need are rare. There are not many people who can do this work, and finding them is the job.

**How we work**

Our process is AI centric, built that way from day one rather than layered onto an old playbook. Sourcing, screening, matching, outreach, scheduling, and pipeline tracking all run on automation, using both the best tools on the market and several we've built ourselves. We expect you to be genuinely interested in that side of the work.

What technology can't do is the rest of it. Once a candidate is in process, they get a real person who picks up the phone, tells them the truth, and checks in daily. Candidates notice, and it's why they come back to us and refer their friends.

**What you'll do**

You will own the process end to end: finding software and AI engineers, talking with them, understanding what they actually want, matching them to open roles across our client base, and staying with them through interviews, offers, and close. Some days it feels like sales and some days it feels like career counseling. Usually both.

* Source and reach out to engineers across AI, ML, infrastructure, and full\-stack
* Screen and interview candidates
* Run multiple candidate processes at the same time
* Coordinate interview loops, prep candidates beforehand, and pass feedback both directions
* Negotiate and close offers
* Build a network you will draw on for the rest of your career

**What we're looking for**

We care more about how you operate than where you have worked. Recruiting experience helps, but many of our best people came in with none.

* Moves quickly, because in this business getting there first usually decides it
* Takes in a great deal of information at once and makes decisions without all of it
* Genuinely curious about technology and what these companies are building
* Competitive
* Takes coaching well, because you will be getting a lot of it
* Extremely organized
* Strong on the phone and in writing

**Compensation and benefits**

* $60,000 to $200,000 first year, based on production
* Health coverage
* Fully remote
* Unlimited PTO, and we mean it, take it
* Direct mentoring from leadership, daily
* Access to tools most recruiters never touch
* Real room to move up as we grow

Remote \| 0 to 2 Years Experience \| First\-Year Target: $60K to $200K

MBS Innovations is a recruiting agency focused on AI and engineering talent. We opened under nine months ago and are already past seven figures in revenue, and we're hiring to keep up. Our founder spent 18 years helping build one of the largest tech staffing agencies in America before starting his own, and he's in the trenches with the team every day rather than managing from a distance. We plan to add 20\+ people before the end of the year.

**Our clients**

We recruit for AI labs, the infrastructure companies much of the industry runs on, and applied AI startups growing quickly. Most are backed by well\-known venture and strategic investors. We also work with Fortune 1000 companies standing up serious AI and engineering teams for the first time.

The work these companies are doing is not incremental. Some are building the models and compute everything else gets built on. Some are working on drug discovery and cutting years off the time it takes to get a treatment to a patient. Some are launching hardware into orbit. Some are rebuilding the power grid, or the tools that let a single engineer do what used to take a team of fifty.

The common thread is that the engineers they need are rare. There are not many people who can do this work, and finding them is the job.

**How we work**

Our process is AI centric, built that way from day one rather than layered onto an old playbook. Sourcing, screening, matching, outreach, scheduling, and pipeline tracking all run on automation, using both the best tools on the market and several we've built ourselves. We expect you to be genuinely interested in that side of the work.

What technology can't do is the rest of it. Once a candidate is in process, they get a real person who picks up the phone, tells them the truth, and checks in daily. Candidates notice, and it's why they come back to us and refer their friends.

**What you'll do**

You will own the process end to end: finding software and AI engineers, talking with them, understanding what they actually want, matching them to open roles across our client base, and staying with them through interviews, offers, and close. Some days it feels like sales and some days it feels like career counseling. Usually both.

* Source and reach out to engineers across AI, ML, infrastructure, and full\-stack
* Screen and interview candidates
* Run multiple candidate processes at the same time
* Coordinate interview loops, prep candidates beforehand, and pass feedback both directions
* Negotiate and close offers

We care more about how you operate than where you have worked. Recruiting experience helps, but many of our best people came in with none.
